items.title: Classic Skyblock
items.creator: Cypress Games
items.description:
Do you have a fear of heights? No problem! You will forget that fear in your adventure traveling from one universe to another on this fun map! It's time to get stronger and set sail on the flying islands!

+ Custom trade system
- 30+ flying islands
+ Hidden chests
+ Perfect for survival

by Cuboid Studios

items.title: Jungle King
items.creator: Mine-North
items.description:
Explore the ruins and fight the jungle king and find all items in the dungeon. Beat the undefeated king and rule over the whole jungle. Have a great adventure at the map Jungle King! 

+ Dungeon
+ Boss fight

Created by Mine-North

items.title: Legacy Heroes
items.creator: JFCrafters
items.description:
Are you in need of a hero ? Well Look no further, the Legacy Heroes are here.
. 20 different skins to go off and save the day.
. Includes 1 free skin.

items.title: Cliff Explorers
items.creator: GoE-Craft
items.description:
Hike to the highest spots and enjoy the view! Look over the edge and get a real thrill in Cliff Explorers skins. Enjoy real excitement in summer, winter, or spring when you role-play with friends as true adventurers. With backpack and hiking pole, trek to the top of a hill or mountain and plant your flag. You made it!

+ 8 sheerly sensational HD skins

items.title: Misfits and Devils
items.creator: House of How
items.description: Live you best dark and evil life with this back of misfit teens and fashionable devils. Show off your punk, emo, goth styles with this alternative pack. 12 skins total!

items.title: Bone Heads
items.creator: PixelOneUp
items.description: Transform into one of the 'Bone Heads' and rattle around the infinite world, all the way to the end. Protect and defend your realm!

items.title: Solar System
items.creator: PixelOneUp
items.description: This pack comes with skins that are dedicated to the solar system which includes everything from the planets, the sun, and the moon. Get your rocket ready and your space shoes on because your journey out of this world starts now!

items.title: Dream Skyblock
items.creator: Vertexcubed
items.description:
Immerse yourself in a sky block straight from your wildest dreams! 

+ Fly around in tamable dragon-like dream bird
+ Multiple dungeons filled with parkour and mobs to PvP against
+ A beautiful and colorful dream world to discover 
+ Guide book with quests to help you through your dream
+ Includes 2 dream skins: fighter and scientist

items.title: Teen Fashionistas
items.creator: Podcrash
items.description:
Fashion is a state of mind! It's an eye for talent and beauty! Do you have what it takes to be the artist of fabric and design?

+ 12 unique role-playing skins

items.title: MASK EMOJI
items.creator: ChewMingo
items.description:
Time to put on your favorite mask and take on the world! This pack includes 10 skins with fun masks to wear.

- 10 Minecraft skins
- Use these skins for roleplay, survival, or online PvP

items.title: Frogs!
items.creator: Razzleberries
items.description:
Show your emotions with a variety of Frog skins!
Whether you are a happy, sad, or cool frog this pack has them all!

+ 12 HD skins!
+ 2 free skins!
+ Includes laughing, angry and tired frog skins!

items.title: Deep Space
items.creator: Dig Down Studios
items.description: It remains unknown what resides at the edges of the universe. Well, that’s what the executives at Delta Cosmos will tell you on your first test launch. It is only once you are finally sent beyond the expanses of this galaxy that you see the full picture. We might glance at the cosmos but the cosmos peer back.

items.title: FIRE LOOKOUT BASE
items.creator: Chunklabs
items.description:
Hike through the mountains, explore the dense mountains and forests and relax in your own private fire lookout base! This base gives you a great view, has a nice interior and a pet to keep you company! In case you plan on taking a friend with you, there is plenty of room for two and even three or four!
+ Fire lookout base
+ Ease your new survival adventure and relax
+ Mine

items.title: Black And White HD Skin Pack
items.creator: CupcakeBrianna
items.description:
A collection of cool and stylish teens wearing the best black and white themed fashion available. Be trendy and aesthetic! 

+ 16 HD skins
+ By CupcakeBrianna

items.title: Multi World Secret Base
items.creator: A30x1
items.description:
Overworld, nether and end. These 2 dimensions compose the Minecraft multiverse, are you ready to discover all the 3 secret bases inside these dimensions? 

* Tip: Stay away from the end base before defeating ender dragon, they will hunt you anywhere in the world!

items.title: Island Fortress
items.creator: A30x1
items.description: To feel safe from zombies, skeletons and spiders. A group of pirates created an island fortress that remains intact for over 200 years, can you explore all it's secrets and make it your own safe house?

items.title: Pretty In Pink 2
items.creator: NovaEGG
items.description: Pink is even better the second time around.

items.title: Rich Mobs HD
items.creator: BBB Studios
items.description: Fancy clothes, shiny jewelry and accessories - show off your wealth as one of these rich and flashy mob characters!

items.title: Portable Bases
items.creator: Dodo Studios
items.description:
Craft these unique portable bases and take them anywhere you like! You can enter them by simply placing them on the ground and right click. When you exit the base, all the changes you made will be saved and it fits right back into your inventory!

- 4 unique bases (farming, mining, lava, millionaire)

items.title: Neon Illusion
items.creator: Pixelationz Studios
items.description: This collection of illusion skins is fun and eye-catching! Choose from many different designs, filled with interesting and colorful patterns. Stand out with these super cool characters!

items.title: Summer Snacks
items.creator: Impulse
items.description:
Your favorite snacks are ready for summer! Be a cute eggplant, an adorable kiwi, or a stylish pickle! A unique summery skin pack perfect for anyone!

+ 12 custom skins for you to choose from!
+ Funny snacks in cute outfits!

items.title: Lucky Block Bed Wars
items.creator: Waypoint Studios
items.description:
Bed Wars + Lucky Blocks is a new twist on your favorite multiplayer game!

Compete with your friends to destroy their beds! But remember to protect your bed at all costs!

items.title: Animal Onesies
items.creator: Waypoint Studios
items.description:
Have you ever wanted to become your favorite animal? Well now is your chance, with the Animal Onesies pack! From a cuddly panda to a ferocious shark, the choice is yours!

- 10 cozy animal onesies
- Diverse selection and attractive look!
- By thiccsnail

items.title: Galactic Warriors
items.creator: Waypoint Studios
items.description:
Hey young warrior! The galaxy needs your help! Foreign forces attacked our universe! Take this skin pack and take on the role of brave galactic warriors and save the galaxy! We won't win without you!

- 10 HD skins 
- Perfect for roleplay
- Cosmic vibe
